question: Should POST /reinstall/applications keep an upper bound of 100 application ids (maxItems 100), or have no upper bound (maxItems removed)?
whyItMatters: The task text allows both: requirement 2 says update maxItems from 25 to 100 'or removed if unbounded'. The choice changes the public API contract: a bound of 100 fails again when installations grow past 100 applications, while no bound accepts arbitrarily large reinstall requests.

options.label: Set maxItems to 100 in appReinstallRequestBody.json
options.consequence: Requests with 1..100 application ids pass; 101+ still get a 400 validation error, so the limit must be raised again for larger installations.

options.label: Remove maxItems from appReinstallRequestBody.json (keep minItems 1)
options.consequence: Any non-empty list is accepted; no future limit changes are needed, but the service no longer rejects very large reinstall requests at validation time.
